format.name: Rule world: chest heart counts who would miss you

title_working: In This World, A Heart On Your Chest Counts Who Would Miss You
world_rule: A heart on every chest counts how many people would miss you.
logline: A lonely quiet kid's heart goes from 0 to 1, and the one person who would miss him is the new girl.

lines.text: In this world, a heart on your chest counts who would miss you.
lines.say: (confident) In this world, a heart on your chest counts who would miss you.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Mine had said zero for as long as I can remember.
lines.say: (sad) Mine had said zero for as long as I can remember.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I was the kid who ate lunch alone in the library.
lines.say: (sad) I was the kid who ate lunch alone in the library.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex, the most popular boy in school, had a zero too.
lines.say: (happy) Rex, the most popular boy in school, had a zero too.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Everyone wanted to be near him. Nobody would miss him.
lines.say: (sad) Everyone wanted to be near him. Nobody would miss him.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then a new girl named Jada joined our class.
lines.say: (happy) Then a new girl named Jada joined our class.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex flexed and bragged, sure she would pick him.
lines.say: (happy) Rex flexed and bragged, sure she would pick him.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I just went back to my book.
lines.say: (sad) I just went back to my book.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The next morning, my heart said one.
lines.say: (surprised) The next morning, my heart said one.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One person would miss me. But who?
lines.say: (nervous) One person would miss me. But who?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: After that, Jada sat with me in the library every day.
lines.say: (happy) After that, Jada sat with me in the library every day.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: We swapped books. We walked home the long way.
lines.say: (happy) We swapped books. We walked home the long way.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: And somewhere along the way, I fell for her.
lines.say: (soft tone) And somewhere along the way, I fell for her.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One rainy afternoon, she tapped my glowing heart and smiled.
lines.say: (soft tone) One rainy afternoon, she tapped my glowing heart and smiled.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She whispered, that one has been me since my first day.
lines.say: (soft tone) She whispered, that one has been me since my first day.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then I looked at her chest. Her heart said one as well.
lines.say: (surprised) Then I looked at her chest. Her heart said one as well.
lines.speaker: narrator
